compositionPrompt: Position the subject in the lower-right foreground along the stone-paved path leading toward the archway. title: 荆州博物馆
modifications: 精美实景重构与旅拍融合。
placementHint: 人物站在前景中央台阶下方或一侧，保留郭沫若题字金色匾额与雕龙花阶。
compositionPrompt: Place the subject in the lower-left or lower-right foreground at the foot of the broad museum steps. Preserve the central entrance, red columns, green glazed tiles and the gold inscribed plaque reading 荆州博物馆. Keep the stone carved dragon balustrades and colorful potted flowers. Match bright clear daylight and upward perspective.
harmonyPrompt: Overcast soft daylight and oblique stair perspective. Use one existing lower step for both feet; choose enough visible space so the subject does not tower above door frames at the same depth. No studio spotlight against the muted facade.

title: 荆州关帝庙
modifications: 精美实景重构与旅拍融合。
placementHint: 人物站在左下方石板步道，与中央香炉古鼎、威震华夏正殿保持纵深层次。
compositionPrompt: Place the subject on the existing lower-left paved walkway, to the left of the central incense burner and statue. Do not stand on planted beds, railings, the burner or the statue plinth. Preserve the central statue and the red-column temple hall behind it. Keep the tree framing and natural courtyard perspective. Match the subdued winter daylight.
harmonyPrompt: Cool, low-contrast winter courtyard with tree-filtered diffuse daylight. Keep subject on the left paved lane around the incense-burner depth, not pushed unnaturally close to the camera. Keep the central Guan Yu statue, plinth and burner clear. Match skin and fabric exposure to the soft shadowed courtyard; no bright orange studio skin or crisp fashion-lit outline.

title: 万寿宝塔
modifications: 精美实景重构与旅拍融合。公开分享改编图须署名并使用 CC BY-SA 3.0。
placementHint: 人物站在林荫甬道靠前位置，完整保留七层八角古塔全貌与苍翠林木。
compositionPrompt: Place the subject on the lower foreground paved path, slightly left of its center. Keep the entire visible seven-storey octagonal pagoda and finial in the background, and do not cover its central silhouette with the subject head. Keep the surrounding trees and railings. Fit the reference height into the square composition rather than cropping the finial. Never put the person on grass, behind the safety railing or inside the sunken tower enclosure. Match diffuse bright daylight.
harmonyPrompt: Diffuse bright daytime under trees. Place the subject at a moderate distance on the path with a small connected shoe contact shadow and soft ambient tree shade. Keep the tower finial complete and avoid a huge close-up person masking lower tower levels.
